title: L1feHunt
description: A simple to use but effective Manhunt plugin that you can use with 2 gamemodes included in the base version.
body:
# **L1feHunt**
Play Manhunt or just use the compass to simply track people.

Tested on 1.21+ Will test future versions soon!

## **Features**
- Multi-Dimensional Compass
- Simple to use GUI
- Multiple Gamemodes (Way more included in L1feHunt Premium when released)
- Config soon.

![Player Select GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b064e93de63aa9d37911e34a1df779b816190c3f.png)

## Manhunt Mode
By turning on manhunt mode with /manhunt, sets everyone to spectator role. Use /runner or /hunter to choose a side. Make sure the runners don't beat you to the end. 

![Tablist in Manhunt mode](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/efd72d3b40a86e5dc6d6428d891288a7f8382287.png)

Runners have 1 Life, once they die they are put in spectator. Hunters have infinite lives with the goal to kill the runner. 

The compass for hunters gets locked to runners only.

## Settings Menu


![Settings Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a190ebec9b250017b5ea32648c4a62a2ef06a19a.png)

Change Tracker, Manhunt, and Twists in the settings menu.

Change the ability to track in the end dimension, or make the compass stay on death.

Play with different twists (Coming soon in L1fehunt Premium). 

(DISCLAIMER) Twists get added slowly to the base version of this plugin slowly. All twists will be available per release for L1fehunt


## **Commands**
Usage:
/hunt <Optional Playername>
  
  Gives Player a compass to track other players (Different functionality when manhunt mode is enabled)
  
Alias: /track, /tracker

/manhunt

  Enables or disables manhunt mode. (Requires OP)

/runner <Optional Playername>

  Puts you on the runner team (If manhunt mode is enabled)
  
/hunter <Optional Playername>

  Puts you on the hunter team (If manhunt mode is enabled)

/spectate <Optional Playername>

  Puts you in spectator (If manhunt mode is enabled)

## **How To Use**

# **Download and Install:**
1. Download Latest Version from versions
2. Add plugin to plugins folder on paper or spigot server (Paper Server tutorial not included) and start server

# **Using**
1. Run /hunt
2. Left click compass to select player
3. Right click compass to update location on compass
4. Run /hunt again to get rid of the compass
